paragraph: smol linux is built from scratch using busybox and musl libc, statically linked, no glibc dependency at all
@!     a custom init written in C, handles mounts + networking + handoff to a shell
@!     smol, a small custom package manager also written in C
@!     a curated, minimal set of static binaries instead of a full glibc userland
this keeps the final image small and dependency-free compared to a typical distro
